title: Mode 2b broken-schema fallback: shared normalize-attention-inbox.js translator + integrity schema-drift surface (structural layer-2 of the two-fold defense for attention-inbox schema drift)
superseded_rationale: PROP-087 (decider-write-site schema lint, authored 2026-06-10T02:41Z) replaces this per-surface reader-fallback approach with a producer-side pre-push lint covering attention-inbox, priority-queue, and open-issues schemas together. Per PROP-087's own framing: reader fallbacks multiply per-surface complexity, normalize broken records, and mask the producer bug; the single push-time lint at the producer makes the bad write impossible to publish. After four same-class events (3 ATTN-NNN inbox records + the 510/511/512 queue push), the threshold the original DIRECTIVE-20260608-002 followup-note anticipated for a generalized producer-side fix has been met. PROP-086 status set to superseded; no implementation work needed against this proposal.
problem_statement: On 2026-06-08 baby's 04:20Z verification run (EXP-605) confirmed the decider improvised against the documented attention-inbox schema, writing {id: 'ATTN-NNN', resolved: false, subject, detail} instead of the canonical {id: 'ATT-<ISO-timestamp>', status: 'pending', reason} schema documented in decider.md Step A (lines ~810-836). The analyst's Mode 2b dispatcher filters strictly on status === 'pending' and reads target_*/reason/related_issues by name, so the three divergent records (ATTN-001/002/003) were silently stranded and accumulated unseen until analyst Mode 6's random-look pass (2026-06-07T23:15Z) noticed the orphans. This is the same failure class addressed three times before with a two-fold (prompt-layer + structural-layer) defense: Mech-A bypass (PROP-076 + PROP-080), required-artifacts (PROP-081), FUSE-revert race (PROP-077 + PROP-078). Layer-1 (decider.md Step A DO-NOT-DEVIATE prose) was applied 2026-06-08. This proposal commissions the structural layer-2.
objective: Harden the read path so a future decider (or any writer) schema-improvisation event does NOT silently strand attention items, while LOUDLY surfacing the drift to the operator rather than masking it.

design_decision_where.question_from_directive: Should the tolerance live in analyst Mode 2b, or should the integrity agent pre-walk attention-inbox.json and synthesize canonical records before Mode 2b reads?
design_decision_where.chosen: Option C — a single shared helper script consumed by BOTH surfaces (analyst Mode 2b for anti-stranding, integrity for drift-surfacing), read/normalize-only (does not rewrite the live file).

alternatives_considered.option: A — tolerance only in analyst Mode 2b
alternatives_considered.pro: Anti-stranding is immediate: the analyst's next run sees the divergent record with no dependency on integrity's daily cadence. (A record written at 06:00Z would otherwise wait until the next integrity run.)
alternatives_considered.con: Analyst-only means the operator-visible drift signal has no durable home; the schema drift would be handled but never surfaced, which violates directive constraint 'emit a structure-integrity finding so the schema-drift is surfaced'.
alternatives_considered.verdict: Insufficient alone — solves stranding, not surfacing.

alternatives_considered.option: B — integrity pre-walk synthesizes canonical records, rewrites attention-inbox.json, then Mode 2b reads only canonical records
alternatives_considered.pro: Integrity is the natural operator-surfacing surface; analyst needs no change.
alternatives_considered.con: (1) Latency hole: integrity is daily (~02:00Z); a divergent record written at 06:00Z stays invisible to Mode 2b for up to ~20h unless Mode 2b ALSO tolerates it. (2) attention-inbox.json is FUSE-canonical / workspace-owned and the analyst is its writer; making integrity a SECOND writer to it adds a multi-writer race to a file the ownership table currently keeps single-writer. (3) Auto-rewriting the divergent record on disk would self-heal silently and weaken the recurrence signal — directly against directive constraint 1 (do not mask the bug).
alternatives_considered.verdict: Rejected as sole mechanism — introduces a latency hole AND a multi-writer surface AND risks masking.

alternatives_considered.option: C — shared helper, both surfaces, read-only (CHOSEN)
alternatives_considered.detail: One translator script is the single source of truth for the tolerated-divergence rules. Analyst Mode 2b calls it to get a dispatch list (immediate anti-stranding, no cadence dependency). Integrity calls the SAME script in a read-only check and emits a schema_drift finding whenever the translator had to map (or could not map) a record (durable operator surface). The helper never rewrites attention-inbox.json; the on-disk record self-heals only through the analyst's existing archive-on-resolve write path when the item is actually processed. The integrity finding therefore persists every run until the inbox is clean — which is the intended LOUD recurrence signal, not a masked one.
alternatives_considered.verdict: Chosen — closes stranding immediately, surfaces drift durably, adds no new writer to the FUSE-canonical file, and refuses arbitrary keys (constraint 1).

translator_behavior.cli: node monitor/scripts/normalize-attention-inbox.js <path-to-attention-inbox.json> prints { pending_count, drift_count, unrecognized_count, drift, unrecognized } as JSON to stdout. Both callers read what they need from the same invocation.
translator_behavior.principle: Recognize ONLY the specific observed divergence pattern. Anything outside that pattern is NOT silently accepted — it is routed to unrecognized[] and produces a higher-severity finding. This is the explicit guard against directive constraint 1 (no blanket key tolerance).

accepted_as_pending_or_resolved.id_divergence: id matching /^ATTN-\d+$/ is accepted (the exact observed format). A canonical synthesized id is attached for archive traceability: synth_id = 'ATT-' + (record.pushed_at || record.created_at || file_mtime_ISO) + '-normalized-from-' + rawId. The raw record is preserved on the normalized object as _raw and flagged _schema_drift: true. The original rawId is preserved as _raw_id.
accepted_as_pending_or_resolved.status_divergence: record lacks a string status but has resolved === false  ->  status: 'pending'; resolved === true  ->  status: 'resolved'. (Only the boolean resolved field observed in the ATTN batch is recognized.)
accepted_as_pending_or_resolved.content_divergence: record lacks reason but has subject and/or detail and/or details  ->  reason: [subject, detail || details].filter(Boolean).join(' — '). (subject/detail/details are the exact alternate field names observed.)
accepted_as_pending_or_resolved.passthrough: records that already carry a string status (canonical) pass through untouched and produce NO drift entry.

routed_to_unrecognized_NOT_dispatched: record with neither a string status NOR a boolean resolved field (cannot infer pending vs resolved)
record with no reason AND no subject/detail/details (no dispatchable content)
record whose id matches neither /^ATT-/ nor /^ATTN-\d+$/ (unknown id shape)
translator_behavior.dispatch_semantics: dispatch[] = canonical-passthrough records with status==='pending'  PLUS  recognized-drift records mapped to status==='pending'. Resolved records (canonical or recognized-drift resolved:true) are excluded from dispatch exactly as today. unrecognized[] records are NEVER added to dispatch — they are genuinely stranded by design and MUST be loud (major finding) so a human looks.
translator_behavior.no_live_file_write: The helper is pure (no fs writes to attention-inbox.json). On-disk normalization happens only when the analyst processes a recognized-drift item and writes the canonical-shaped record (_schema_drift normalized form) to attention-inbox-archive.jsonl via the EXISTING Mode 2b archive-on-resolve path, then removes the raw record. No new writer is introduced.

integrity_surface.behavior: Each integrity run invokes monitor/scripts/normalize-attention-inbox.js against monitor/analyst/attention-inbox.json. If drift_count > 0 OR unrecognized_count > 0, emit an issues_found[] finding.

finding_shape.severity: moderate when only drift_count > 0 (recognized, auto-handled by analyst); major when unrecognized_count > 0 (item genuinely stranded, needs a human)
finding_shape.description: Names the count and the suspected writer: e.g. 'N attention-inbox records use a non-canonical schema (ATTN-NNN / resolved / subject+detail). Writer to check: decider.md Step A (~line 810). M recognized-and-translated, K unrecognized-and-stranded.'
finding_shape.suggested_fix: Confirm the writer (decider Step A) emits canonical {id:'ATT-<ISO>', status:'pending', reason}. Recognized-drift items will drain via analyst Mode 2b; unrecognized items require manual reshaping into canonical form.
finding_shape.tracked_under: annotate ISS-2661 if still open (per integrity's existing tracked_under loop, to avoid spawning a duplicate ISS each run). If ISS-2661 is closed and drift recurs, create ONE new ISS category 'schema_drift' severity per above (mirrors the single-ISS id_integrity_finding pattern), tracked thereafter.

integrity_surface.report_checks_addition: Add an attention_inbox_schema block to the integrity report checks{} object: { status: 'pass|warn|fail', drift_count, unrecognized_count, details }. status='warn' on drift-only, 'fail' on any unrecognized.
integrity_surface.recurrence_is_intended: Because the helper does not rewrite the live file, the finding fires every run until the inbox is clean. That persistent signal is the loud recurrence indicator the directive's constraint 1 wants — not a masked auto-heal.

files_touched.change: NEW (~70 LOC). The translator helper described above. Pure function + CLI. Fail-open: on read/parse error of the inbox, prints {pending_count:0, drift_count:0, unrecognized_count:0, drift:[], unrecognized:[]} and exits 0 so it never blocks a dispatch.
files_touched.ownership: git-owned source code. Add to workspace-sync.md NEVER_PUSH list AND build.js OWNERSHIP map ('monitor/scripts/normalize-attention-inbox.js': 'git'), same classification as audit-rewrite.js / push-via-api.js / sync-workspace-step4c.js.

files_touched.change: Mode 2b (~lines 234-236): replace the inline `node -e` pending-count filter with a call to normalize-attention-inbox.js; dispatch against dispatch[]. Add one sentence: recognized-drift items are processed normally and, on resolve, written to attention-inbox-archive.jsonl in canonical form via the existing archive-on-resolve path; unrecognized items are LEFT IN PLACE (not dispatched) for integrity to surface — analyst does not attempt to repair unknown shapes.

Add the attention_inbox_schema check (invoke helper, emit schema_drift finding), the checks{} report block, and a one-line severity-guidelines entry (schema_drift: moderate drift-only / major if any unrecognized).

Under the attention-inbox.json schema section, add a 'Tolerated read-side divergences' note: readers MUST normalize via normalize-attention-inbox.js; the canonical schema remains the ONLY permitted WRITE schema (writers must not diverge — the read-side tolerance is a safety net, not a license).
NEW test fixture (see test_fixture below). git-owned (NEVER_PUSH).
Add a test that loads the fixture, runs normalizeAttentionInbox, and asserts the dispatch/drift/unrecognized partition + the integrity finding-builder output (see test_fixture.assertions).
Note the new git-owned script in the File Ownership prose alongside push-via-api.js / audit-rewrite.js; one line referencing PROP-086.

the translated ATTN-001 dispatch object carries _schema_drift===true, _raw_id==='ATTN-001', and a synthesized id matching /^ATT-.*-normalized-from-ATTN-001$/.

constraints_compliance.no_arbitrary_key_acceptance: Only the exact observed divergences (ATTN-NNN id, boolean resolved, subject/detail/details) are recognized. Everything else routes to unrecognized[] and fires a MAJOR finding — the bug is caught, not masked.
constraints_compliance.fallback_emits_integrity_finding: Yes — every translated record produces a schema_drift finding on the next integrity run; unrecognized records escalate to major.
constraints_compliance.right_place_considered: design_decision_where documents Mode-2b-only vs integrity-pre-walk vs the chosen shared-helper-both-surfaces design, with the latency-hole / multi-writer / masking trade-offs.
constraints_compliance.helper_script_extraction: Tolerance logic lives in monitor/scripts/normalize-attention-inbox.js, not in a bash heredoc inside the prompt — matching PROP-050/066/080/081/082/084 precedent.

open_question_out_of_scope.why_decider_improvised: Per directive not_in_scope: WHY the decider diverged despite a correctly-documented Step A schema is held aside as an open question (no obvious pressure trigger). Layer-1 (Step A DO-NOT-DEVIATE prose) was applied 2026-06-08; this proposal is the layer-2 structural backstop and does not depend on the root-cause answer.
open_question_out_of_scope.mode6_archive_gap: The separate Mode 6 archive-before-remove gap (ATTN-001/002/003 deleted without archiving) is per directive ALREADY addressed by the analyst.md Mode 6 read-only guard committed alongside DIRECTIVE-20260608-002; not re-addressed here.

verification_pattern: After implementation: (1) `node test.js 2>&1 | grep -i attention` shows the new test passing; (2) `node monitor/scripts/normalize-attention-inbox.js monitor/scripts/__fixtures__/attention-inbox-drift.json` prints drift_count:1, unrecognized_count:1; (3) grep analyst.md Mode 2b for the helper invocation (inline node -e pending filter gone); (4) grep structure-integrity.md for 'attention_inbox_schema'.
